document_title: Comprehensive Physical Commissioning Acceptance Matrix V2
epistemic_mandate: NO GATE MAY PASS BASED ON ARCHITECTURAL ASSUMPTIONS OR SYNTHETIC SIMULATION. Every gate requires on-site physical measurement, calibrated instrumentation, physical evidence artifacts, and signed operator certification.

commissioning_gates.requirement: IEEE 1588-2019 Grandmaster clock locked with >= 8 GNSS satellites; camera P99 offset <= 5.0 ms, CAN P99 offset <= 10.0 ms, secondary sensor P99 offset <= 8.0 ms; composite multi-modal skew <= 33.33 ms (nominal 18.0 ms, reserve 15.33 ms).
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-modal optical strobe and physical impactor captured simultaneously by cameras and vehicle accelerometer, with PTP 1PPS probe monitoring.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope + Vector VN1640A Interface + Co-Calibration Impactor Strobe Rig
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: actual_composite_skew <= 33.33 ms AND camera_offset <= 5.0 ms AND can_offset <= 10.0 ms AND secondary_offset <= 8.0 ms
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Abort commissioning; inspect GNSS antenna; check PTP priority and TSN switch queues.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All deployed cameras (A, C, and B/D if present) rigidly mounted with 9.5 N*m torque; focus and aperture mechanically locked with set-screws; zero dropped frames over 30-min continuous ingest.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Calibrated torque wrench physical audit of mounting bolts and lens barrels; Wireshark automated frame drop monitor on RTSP/GigE streams.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Norbar Calibrated Torque Wrench (1.0-20.0 N*m, ISO 6789) + Wireshark Network Packet Monitor
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: frame_drop_count == 0 over 30 min across all deployed cameras AND all mount bolt torques == 9.5 N*m
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-tighten mounts; replace damaged Ethernet cables; optimize NIC ring buffer.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All MANDATORY_RAW_SIGNALS active, monotonic timestamps, continuous streaming (zero packet gaps > 20ms), SI units confirmed, steering_rate derivation verified via 2nd-order Butterworth filter, brake_pressure_bar marked UNAVAILABLE.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus tap monitoring 50 Hz frames during low-speed shakedown roll.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Vector CANoe with VN1640A non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus interface
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: can_packet_gap_max_ms <= 20.0 ms AND zero corrupt frames AND all mandatory signals streaming with monotonic timestamps
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Verify CAN baud rate (500 kbps); inspect terminating resistor (120 Ohm); re-seat OBD/J1939 tap.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Secondary Hazard Zone Volume-Based Observability Proof
commissioning_gates.requirement: 3D spatial grid sweep across secondary cross-aisle volume (36 points, 0m to 20m depth, 3.5m width, 0.8-1.8m height); Camera C achieves >= 65.0 px/m resolution at 20m depth; CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA == 0.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Physical volumetric target sweep with standardized photometric mannequin target (SPMT-01) across 3D measurement grid; automated OpenCV pixel resolution audit.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Measure + OpenCV target resolution validator + SPMT-01 Target
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: depth_extent >= 20.0 m AND pixel_density_at_20m >= 65.0 px/m AND CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA == 0.0 m^2
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-aim Camera C; adjust optical focal length; clear pallet rack overhangs; declare zone UNVERIFIED if blocked.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Intrinsic & Extrinsic Geometric Calibration (All Deployed Cameras)
commissioning_gates.requirement: Photogrammetric calibration across all deployed cameras (A, C, and B/D if present); RMS reprojection error <= 1.50 px using 12x9 ChArUco diamond board. Undeployed cameras marked NOT_APPLICABLE.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-pose ChArUco diamond board physical acquisition (50+ diverse board angles per camera); OpenCV pinhole camera model bundle adjustment.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Calib.io Certified Precision Aluminum ChArUco Calibration Target (12x9 grid)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: rms_reprojection_error_px <= 1.50 px across all deployed cameras (Camera D marked NOT_APPLICABLE if absent)
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-run calibration capture with improved target lighting; inspect lens distortion profile.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Total Station survey defining facility brass origin monument, floor ground plane equation Ax+By+Cz+D=0 (residual RMS <= 3.0 mm), travel corridor boundaries, and exclusion zone perimeter.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Licensed geodetic survey using reflectorless optical total station referencing permanent building structural columns.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica TS16 Total Station (1" angle accuracy, 1mm + 1.5ppm EDM)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: ground_plane_rms_residual_mm <= 3.0 mm AND facility monument coordinates locked in local Cartesian CRS
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-survey ground plane targets; re-establish tie points; verify floor slab settlement.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Physical Corridor Illuminance & High-Frequency Flicker Commissioning
commissioning_gates.requirement: Path 1: Physical lux meter measurement confirming mean illuminance within 350 +/- 50 lux across 5 corridor points. Path 2: Dedicated optical flicker meter/oscilloscope confirming flicker index <= 0.05 and driver frequency >= 1000 Hz.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Dual-path audit: Static photometer grid sweep across corridor + high-speed photodiode oscilloscope trace under optical axis.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Path 1: Testo 540 / Gossen Mavolux 5032B Lux Meter. Path 2: Thorlabs PDA36A2 Fast Photodetector + Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope.
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: 300.0 lux <= mean_lux <= 400.0 lux AND flicker_index <= 0.05 AND modulation_frequency >= 1000.0 Hz
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Adjust warehouse luminaire dimmers; replace faulty LED ballast drivers; install diffuser panels.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: E-Stop Safety Circuit & Traction Cutoff Latency Acceptance
commissioning_gates.requirement: Dedicated wireless remote E-Stop with vendor notified body Cat 4 / SIL-3 certificate; oscilloscope trace proves traction motor power disconnect (t_traction_safe_state - t_estop_command) <= 50.0 ms.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: 4-channel isolated digital storage oscilloscope measuring E-Stop NC switch break vs motor phase current isolation and brake solenoid drop.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G 4-Channel Oscilloscope connected to E-Stop receiver and motor drive line
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: measured_traction_safe_latency <= 50.0 ms AND vendor Cat 4 / SIL-3 certificate on file
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Inspect emergency contactor coil spring; replace slow auxiliary relay; reject uncertified hardware.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Physical microphone disconnection/desoldering on all cameras; formal bilateral Data Agreement executed between Research Consortium, Facility Operating Company, and Labor Safety Representatives.
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Physical hardware visual inspection of camera PCB audio traces + cryptographic signature verification on legal agreement.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Visual hardware inspection + cryptographic document ledger
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: microphone_physically_disconnected == TRUE across all cameras AND formal_site_agreement_signed == TRUE
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Physical desoldering/jumpers of camera microphone traces; halt all capture until agreement signed.
